parent.digest: the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the issue's body field as the GitHub REST API returns it

evidence.model: a finite-bound model check of a projection of the accepted protocol, with its bounds
evidence.simulation: seeded runs of the production simulation world: counts, work and ticks, never hardware latency
evidence.hardware: class-bound hardware-lane receipts on a supported platform row of scripts/hardware-profiles.json
evidence.store: control-plane store observations, conditional on the store contract's qualification

warm-takeover.meaning: the recorded standby takes over the retained volume at the same volume identity and generation and restores the eligible set S from the certified cut

same-host-restart.meaning: the owner host restarts on its own volume and restores S from the certified cut

volume-loss-control.meaning: actual volume loss, or an expressly labeled control, provisions a replacement volume and starts cold; it never stands for host loss

population.census: a per-application census at the cut, kept apart from the input manifest
population.initial_state: only the system's own FILL, capture and Publish on a fresh volume

example.use: an example client workload for reproduction only

arrival.buckets: one terminal bucket per original request
arrival.attempts: attempts are counted apart from original requests
arrival.censoring: a timeout is censored at its deadline and ranks above every completed latency; the hit gate's samples format records no timeout or deadline, so each outcome's tail holds its completed latencies uncensored and a cell holding errors reads inconclusive

first_safe_hit.estimand: time from the kill or the flip request to the first read that ended complete at Live

hardware.computation: subtracts the fault injector's kill or flip-request wall time from the wall time of the recovery report's first safe hit, its poll tick converted by the run's recorded tick-to-wall mapping

retained_hit_recovery.estimand: time until the demand-weighted share of S served by hits reaches each level

hardware.computation: weights each S member's first verified client hit by the population's reference weights and reads the time each level is reached

sustained_fill_readiness.estimand: the first time from which fill admission and completion rates stay in the policy's band of the pre-cut rates for the policy's window

hardware.computation: compares the client's fill admission and completion rates with the pre-cut rates from the first fill at Live

rto.estimand: per class, time from the kill or the flip request to the first accepted GET

hardware.computation: reads the fault injector's kill or flip-request time and the client's first accepted GET on one clock

request_tail.estimand: per-request latency from scheduled send over every original request, stratified by phase and by outcome, each outcome's tail over its completed latencies

hardware.computation: reads the hit-gate samples file of each run

origin_demand.estimand: origin fetches the client issues after the cut

hardware.computation: counts the client's origin fetches after the cut

simulation.computation: counts the world's origin fetches after the cut

goodput.estimand: verified hit bytes per second at the offered load

hardware.computation: sums verified hit bytes over the run's span from the samples file

held_capacity.estimand: allocator units the warm bootstrap holds restored

peak_ram.estimand: the peak host RAM in use over the run

hardware.computation: takes the largest Headroom ram reading among the host reports sampled over the run

hit_latency.estimand: H: from the intended send to the last verified hit byte, by size stratum, with p50 and p99.9, errors, misses and the background-activity phase reported

hardware.computation: the hit gate's samples and judgment

fill_latency.estimand: F: from the intended send to the FILL acknowledgment at insert

hardware.draft: A FILL-acknowledgment cell drives open-loop FILLs and records each from its intended send to the acknowledgment at insert, with the device write reported apart and no store call on the acknowledgment path.

device_read.estimand: device read latency, a diagnostic kept apart from H and F

hardware.draft: Each hit and FILL cell reports the device read and write histograms apart from the client timing.

store_requests.estimand: control-plane store requests by kind (Confirm, Publish, fence, coverage add, flip, attempt-counter bump) and item, per publication and per invalidation or replacement call

store.draft: The store client counts requests by kind (Confirm, Publish, fence, coverage add, flip, attempt-counter bump) and item, with C_page in these rows only.

hardware.draft: The host reports the store client's per-kind request counts after a driven scenario.

checkpoint_units.estimand: checkpoint units written per publication and read by the named load, per mutation

hardware.computation: divides the units each publication writes by the mutations since the previous publication

simulation.computation: divides the units each publication writes by the mutations since the previous publication

capture_duration.estimand: duration of each capture pass from its start to its published proof

hardware.draft: The host report carries each capture pass's duration from its start to its published proof, labeled by its end state.

capture_abandonment.estimand: capture passes abandoned in the entry's tenure

side_list_peak.estimand: the side-list peak of a capture pass against Q_cap

hardware.draft: The host report carries each capture pass's side-list peak in entries and words against its SideCap.

s_membership.estimand: the count of members of the eligible set S at the certified cut

simulation.computation: the oracle's retained set of the activation

hardware.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds lists the members of S the warm load installed and those it omitted, by cause.

certified_cut.estimand: the checkpoint cut LSN of the shard record the activation restores from, where its suffix replay starts

certified_frontier.estimand: the certified end of the last suffix the shard record's ancestry names, the durability frontier the activation's replay must reach

eligible_exclusions.estimand: entries leaving S only through a recorded eviction, acknowledged invalidation, expiry or successful replacement

hardware.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds counts the S members that left S only through a recorded eviction, acknowledged invalidation, expiry or successful replacement, by cause.

fault_local_damage.estimand: damaged physical units with the entries and dependencies they affect

hardware.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds lists each damaged physical unit with the entries and dependencies it affects.

simulation.computation: counts each physical unit the world's recorded faults damaged once, and lists the S members and dependencies each damaged unit holds

preserved_unaffected_bytes.estimand: bytes of S members no damaged unit holds that the successor serves

simulation.computation: sums the oracle's served bytes of retained-set members whose units no recorded fault damaged or repaired

hardware.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds counts the bytes of installed S members the client then hit.

protected_history_pressure.estimand: frontier, ancestry, quarantine and full gauges of the protected history against their bounds

interruption_ancestry.estimand: the ancestry an interrupted takeover chain leaves, and the lineage the successor preempts

hardware.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds lists the ancestry an interrupted takeover chain leaves and the lineage the successor preempts.

simulation.computation: reads the shard record's retained suffixes after each interrupted takeover in the world and the registration each successor's preempt names

request_attempts.estimand: GET retransmissions the client queues over the measured interval, counted apart from the original requests

hardware.draft: The client reports its FetchReport get_retries counter at the start and the end of each measured interval beside the interval's original request count.

l_data_ratio.estimand: the recovery's measured elapsed time over L_data, the time the calibration's C2 rates give for the bytes, operations, RAM build and CPU work the recovery performed

hardware.computation: divides the measured recovery time by L_data computed from the calibration's rates and the recovery's counted bytes, operations, built index bytes and CPU work

candidate_validation.estimand: time the warm load spends validating candidates, apart from their reads and their install

hardware.draft: The warm activation reports the time it spends validating candidates, apart from the reads and the install.

activation_fences.estimand: fence requests the store client issues per activation

hardware.draft: The host reports the store client's fence request count per activation after a driven scenario.

simulation.computation: counts the simulated store's fence requests per activation

cold_refill.estimand: for the volume-loss control, time from the replacement volume's attach until origin refill restores the pre-fault hit share

hardware.computation: reads the replacement volume's attach time and the first client window whose hit share reaches the pre-fault share on one clock

origin_excess.estimand: origin fetches over the recovery window above the pre-fault origin rate

hardware.computation: subtracts the pre-fault origin rate times the window from the origin fetches the client issues in the recovery window

simulation.computation: subtracts the pre-fault origin rate times the window from the origin fetches the world counts in the recovery window

engine_charge.estimand: engine memory bytes charged per shard at the N_max column the cell's header declares

hardware.computation: reads each shard's engine charge at the end of its activation under the cell's N_max

simulation.computation: reads each shard's engine charge at the end of its activation under the cell's N_max

activation_cpu.estimand: CPU seconds one shard's activation spends

hardware.computation: reads the activating threads' CPU time at the start and the end of the shard's activation

serving_cpu.estimand: CPU seconds per shard spent serving over the measured interval

hardware.computation: reads the serving threads' CPU time at the start and the end of the measured interval

foreground_use.estimand: foreground use of the resource the cell's stratum names under the peak tape, as a share of its calibrated capacity

hardware.computation: divides the resource's foreground use over the peak tape by its calibrated capacity

put_refusals.estimand: PUTs the owner refuses over the measured interval; a PUT's delay is F

hardware.computation: counts the refused PUT replies the client receives in the measured interval

simulation.computation: counts the refused PUTs the world records in the measured interval

recent_unprotected_suffix.estimand: acknowledged fills past the certified frontier that no protected suffix holds, which the recovery does not restore

hardware.computation: counts the acknowledged fills after the certified frontier that the successor does not serve

simulation.computation: counts the acknowledged fills after the certified frontier that the successor does not serve

detection.estimand: from the injected fault to the standby's nomination

hardware.computation: reads the fault injector's time and the standby detector's nomination time

fresh_host_attachment.estimand: from the reconciler's attach of a designated fresh host to its controller-ready report

hardware.draft: The reconciler's fresh-host path records the attach request and the controller-ready time of the designated host.

authority.estimand: from the nomination to the acknowledged takeover compare-and-swap

hardware.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds stamps the acknowledged takeover CAS.

coverage.estimand: from the acknowledged CAS until every coverage page is fenced under the new session

hardware.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds stamps the fence of the last coverage page.

read_decode_install.estimand: from the start of the warm load's reads to the install of every verified candidate

hardware.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds stamps the start of the warm load's reads and the install commit of its last verified candidate on one clock.

first_correct_recovered_hit.estimand: from the fence of the last coverage page under the new session, which completes the authority checks and coverage installation, to the client's first verified hit on a member of S

hardware.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds stamps the fence of the last coverage page and the first verified client hit on an installed S member on one clock.

full_load_readiness.estimand: from the fence of the last coverage page under the new session to the start of the first policy window at full offered load whose hits meet the H ceilings

hardware.draft: The recovery record a credited receipt binds stamps the fence of the last coverage page, and the client names the first sample window at full offered load that meets the H ceilings, on one clock.

volume_bandwidth.estimand: EBS bytes per second one volume sustains at the qualified read and write shape

hardware.computation: measures one volume's sustained bytes per second at the qualified shape apart from every scored run

volume_iops.estimand: EBS operations per second one volume sustains at the qualified read and write shape

hardware.computation: measures one volume's sustained operations per second at the qualified shape apart from every scored run

host_bandwidth.estimand: EBS bytes per second the host sustains over every volume it attaches

hardware.computation: measures the host's sustained EBS bytes per second over its attached volumes apart from every scored run

host_iops.estimand: EBS operations per second the host sustains over every volume it attaches

hardware.computation: measures the host's sustained EBS operations per second over its attached volumes apart from every scored run

ram_build_rate.estimand: index bytes the warm load builds in RAM per second

hardware.computation: measures the index build rate of a warm load over resident candidates apart from every scored run

worker_cpu.estimand: CPU seconds one recovery worker spends per verified candidate

hardware.computation: measures one worker's CPU time over a counted batch of verified candidates apart from every scored run

worker_slots.estimand: recovery-worker slots the host runs under the policy's foreground reservation

hardware.computation: measures the worker count at which the foreground keeps its reserved share apart from every scored run

contrasts.class: arm A runs the volume-loss control and arm B the block's class on one build, both under the block's posture; a descriptive contrast with no bound verdict
contrasts.revision: arm A runs the baseline build and arm B the candidate, both on the block's class and posture; the bound verdict decides

sets.null: A/A blocks of one arm and posture, whose bounds must each be bounded, which takes at least the fewest blocks the order bound bounds at its per-tail level, lie within plus or minus the member's tolerance and cover zero; a result within that band is evidence of no bias at that size, not proof of none
sets.pilot: blocks that size the held-out floors and the tolerance and never count toward confirmation
sets.held-out: the fixed-horizon confirmation blocks the bounds and verdicts read

columns.store: Conditional: #123 records no ST1 to ST8 qualification

requalification: rerun the scheduled long-run rows of blotter issue 1193 with sustained-load tapes
rerun the leak, always-miss, retention and attribution controls
rerun the touched model cases of #136 and the components of #122
rerun the goldens of #125 when a history row field changes
run python3 scripts/judge-verus.py reconcile with a Verus receipt when a Verus-included file changes
run python3 scripts/test-classify-atomics.py for a changed shared atomic site
frozen: one outstanding shard-record request per tenure (T18)
the removal hook before a unit's release

aa.meaning: two arms of one revision and posture: every paired contrast's simultaneous bound covers zero within plus or minus its member's tolerance

always-miss.meaning: an arm that answers every GET with a miss fails retention of S

leaked-capacity.meaning: a planted leak of held units fails the plateau band

foreground-hog.meaning: a foreground CPU hog on the owner's cores fails the H ceilings

advertised-rate.meaning: an arm run at the device's advertised rate instead of the calibrated rate credits nothing

calibration-drift.meaning: every C2 term's relative drift between its start and end calibrations, over the intervals their declared half-widths give, is at most the statistics version's drift band

discipline.digest_gate: every host's reference-workload outcome file hashes equal to the reference host's of its CPU family before its runs count
discipline.jobs: watchdogs and deadlines are sized at the loaded rate, with at most one job per physical core
discipline.censored: a censored run is a terminal outcome
discipline.clock: every host states clock trust, and an untrusted host's cells read degraded

P-N-341.name: evidence-columns-name-their-own-identity
P-N-341.falsifier: a hardware cell passing from a simulator campaign

P-N-344.name: optimization-carries-one-measured-target
P-N-344.falsifier: an INCONCLUSIVE bound verdict merged as a performance change
